world.title: 金属盐在溶液中长成矿物花园
world.posterTitle: 金属盐落下，矿物花园开始生长
world.posterHook: 沉淀膜在渗透压下膨胀、破裂，有时反复重封，把无生命的盐长成彩色中空管。
world.posterSource: 原创 Three.js / R3F 定性机制模型 · 沉淀、渗透压与浮力
world.question: 一颗金属盐落进溶液，为什么会像植物一样向上生长？
world.hook: 盐粒沉到一片几乎看不见的水下舞台。它先包起一层薄膜，在一些条件下反复增压、破裂和重封，长出青绿、赭金和紫红色的中空矿物管。
world.payoff: 化学花园不是晶体发芽，而是自组装的沉淀管：金属盐与硅酸盐相遇形成半透膜，水因浓度差进入并抬高内压；膜破裂后，在这里较轻的内部溶液受浮力偏向上升，并在新的界面继续沉淀成管壁。这个世界演示上升型、脉冲式生长的定性因果，但不预测真实实验的尺寸、速度或枝形。
world.topicLabel: 化学自组织 · 沉淀与渗透

en.title: Metal salts grow into a mineral garden in solution
en.posterTitle: Drop a Metal Salt. Watch a Mineral Garden Grow.
en.posterHook: Osmotic pressure swells and ruptures a precipitate membrane; sometimes it reseals, growing lifeless salt into colored hollow tubes.
en.posterSource: Original Three.js / R3F qualitative mechanism model · precipitation, osmosis, and buoyancy
en.question: Why can a metal salt dropped into solution grow upward like a plant?
en.hook: Salt grains fall onto an almost invisible underwater stage. Each wraps itself in a membrane and, under some conditions, repeatedly pressurizes, ruptures, and reseals into turquoise, ochre, and violet hollow mineral tubes.
en.payoff: A chemical garden is not a sprouting crystal but a self-assembled precipitate tube. Metal salt and silicate form a semipermeable membrane; a concentration difference draws water in and raises the pressure. When the membrane ruptures, the lighter inner solution in this upward-growing regime tends to rise under buoyancy and precipitates a new tube wall at its interface. This world illustrates that qualitative, pulsed causal sequence but does not predict experimental dimensions, speeds, or exact branching.
